description: This file defines an interface for representing JSON keys within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes a static factory method to create JSON key instances and a method to convert the key into a JSON pointer.

classes.name: JsonKey
classes.description: An interface representing a JSON key, providing methods to create instances and obtain a JSON pointer.

methods.name: of
methods.description: A static method that creates a JsonKey instance from a provided character sequence, throwing exceptions if input is null or empty.

methods.name: asPointer
methods.description: An abstract method to convert this JSON key into a JSON pointer.
